svg.title: Banneret — passive tree, one shared map
svg.desc: One passive tree shared by the party. Each hero starts beside his portrait and allocates his own nodes; a node can be taken by several heroes. Node colour codes the mechanic. Around each taken node, an arc in the hero's colour sits on the side facing that hero's portrait. A ring road links the three starts. Each hero has four class regions with a keystone; behind it, three ascensions with their own keystones. Bridges join regions across hero borders by shared mechanic: bleed between berserker and ranger, fire between spellblade and wizard, curses between warlock and hexblade. Sample mid-run with the warrior's paths highlighted. Names, counts and allocations are illustrative. Static SVG mockup.
svg.text: LAYOUT TEST · mid-run sample. Node colour = mechanic. Arc around a node = the hero who took it. Names, node counts and allocations are illustrative.
Arcs sit on the side facing their hero's portrait: warrior on top, caster lower right, skirmisher lower left. Gold lines: the selected hero's paths.
Red: bleed, stagger, armour break · Yellow: seals, renew · Blue: channeling, fire, shield · Green: poison, combo, evasion · Purple: blood magic, curses · Grey: forms
